name: Investment Visa (I)

requirements.blocker_text: The Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own visa schedule specifies an Investment (I) visa for a foreign investor contributing a minimum of 10 million Kyrgyz soms, issued multiple-entry only, valid 12-36 months. Separately, the government's own e-visa portal describes an Investment (I) category valid 5-10 years 'based on contribution amount' -- a genuine discrepancy between two official government sources on visa duration (the capital threshold itself is not disputed between the two).
requirements.fix_path: Make a qualifying investment of at least 10 million Kyrgyz soms and apply for the Investment visa.

evidence_required.document: Proof of investment (10 million soms minimum)

outcome.duration_length: 12-36 months per the MFA's consular schedule; 5-10 years per the e-visa portal's own description, scaled to contribution size -- this dataset does not resolve the discrepancy

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic -- Investment (I) visa: 10 million som minimum contribution, multiple-entry, 12-36 months
Kyrgyz Republic e-Visa government portal -- Investment (I) visa: 5-10 years validity based on contribution amount

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kyrgyzstan). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- this is a genuine, positive standout finding: unlike Bolivia, Angola, Cameroon, Congo-Brazzaville, Libya, and Mozambique earlier in this dataset (all of which had NO confirmed minimum investment threshold), Kyrgyzstan's own Ministry of Foreign Affairs publishes a concrete, numeric figure -- 10 million Kyrgyz soms -- directly in its own consular visa schedule. GENUINE, DISCLOSED DISCREPANCY: the MFA's page and the government's own e-visa portal disagree on the visa's validity period (12-36 months vs. 5-10 years) -- both being tier-1 government sources, this is presented as an open discrepancy between two official pages rather than resolved by picking one. citizenship_after_months (36) reflects Article 13(2)'s reduced 3-year naturalization track for 'priority economic investments' (see kg_citizenship_naturalisation.json), which this dataset judges likely applicable to a qualifying investor, though the exact threshold for what counts as a 'priority' investment under that clause was not separately confirmed.
